title: Email inbox
description: Customers, staff and partners email feedback to these addresses. Each email is checked, deduplicated and redacted before it becomes a feedback item.
notDeployed: The email inbox is not deployed. Deploy with -c inboundEmailDomain=<your domain> (see docs/email-intake.md).
ruleSetInactive: The receipt rule set {{ruleSet}} is not active, so no email arrives yet. Activate it in Amazon SES, or redeploy into the active rule set with -c inboundEmailRuleSet.

pii.redact: Personal data is redacted: names, email addresses and phone numbers are replaced before storage.
pii.allow: Personal data is kept as received (the source profile allows it).
pii.summary_only: Only derived fields are kept (the source profile is summary only).

dimension.missing: Create the Feedback type dimension so the ideas@, bugs@ and reviews@ addresses and subject tags such as [bug] label each item.

errors.load: The email inbox status could not be loaded.
errors.save: The limits could not be saved.
errors.dimension: The dimension could not be created.
